capex: Cash flow side, of course, this is what it is, this is still the Q1, so you know there is a lot of, you know, money that we need to put into CapEx 4.2 crores already gone in there.
Aditya Maruti Gokarn: Yeah, so I'd say CapEx wise at the group level, we want to invest about 15 cores this year.
risks: I think every car maker, every vehicle manufacturer in the world today knows that the next five to ten years, the biggest challenge is going to be Supply chain, there's going to be disruption, there's more in the pipelin
So, to put in a summarized form, I don't see any challenges for us to sustain this growth momentum through the rest of this year in automotive.
focus: If you look at the new products, there's a lot of EV components that we're working on and the sales in these in this segment has also been fairly good for us in the quarter.
So we are not falling prey to the temptation to just, you know, enter the market just at a very low price and by sacrificing August 21,2026 Page 5 of 43 margins, we are right now not doing that.
EV two wheeler growth I think will continue, right and there we are adding capacity, we will be able to add capacity quickly enough so that we don't lose any opportunities, right.
